foundation.heading: The Yunus Ajibola Gafar Foundation
paragraphs: A scholarship that began in 2008/2009 had supported over fifty students by 2018/2019. After the founder's passing, it became a foundation in his name.
On 4 June 2026, the Foundation commissioned a solar-powered borehole for Alagbado Phase II, Eyenkorin, Kwara State.
foundation.note: The Foundation is completing its formal registration.
